title: Sanitize non-finite Body proxy radius before morphology fallback
description:
## Summary
Prevent non-finite authored Body radii from poisoning the compact anatomical influence-radius bridge before its documented fallback can apply.

## User Mandate
> Ensure everything important is tracked and do not weaken validation or hide malformed-state behavior.

## Scope
- Sanitize the initial Body proxy radius before any Mathf.Max/Distance-based accumulation.
- Preserve the existing deterministic fallback value and resolved-morphology behavior for valid radii.
- Add direct regression coverage for NaN and Infinity on segment-bearing Body morphology.

## Acceptance Criteria
- NaN/Infinity authored Body radius never produces NaN/Infinity in the returned per-bone radius array.
- Valid morphology and existing midpoint/clamping behavior are unchanged.
- Focused runtime tests/build remain green.

## Validation
Unity PlayMode remains required for task closure; source/build validation is not sufficient to mark Done.

## Findings
Round 23 audit identified that the caller sanitizes an invalid radius but ResolveBodyProxyRadius rereads raw BoneSpec.Radius; a non-finite value can therefore poison the fallback accumulator.

## Next Step
Sanitize the proxy radius at method entry and add NaN/Infinity regression cases.
